thought.text:
**Ini akar masalahnya.** ResiFactory **rotating** — setiap request IP baru, walau session sama:

```
47.149.11.204 → 107.77.216.186 → 73.101.60.135 → 184.55.207.182
```

Jadi token dibuat dari IP A, tapi submit datang dari IP B → **Turnstile menolak**. Ini persis dugaan saya.

Saya cek Proxidize — formatnya punya parameter session.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && S="sticky$RANDOM"; P="http://jPDZYa2fSH3jMmQN-s-$S-co-US-type-residential:bHaUJVMb4cPlQZOL@pg.proxi.es:20000"; echo "sesi=$S"; for i in 1 2 3 4; do printf "req$i: "; curl -s --max-time 40 -x "$P" https://api.ipify.org; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && S=\"sticky$RANDOM\"; P=\"http://jPDZYa2fSH3jMmQN-s-$S-co-US-type-residential:bHaUJVMb4cPlQZOL@pg.proxi.es:20000\"; echo \"sesi=$S\"; for i in 1 2 3 4; do printf \"req$i: \"; curl -s --max-time 40 -x \"$P\" https://api.ipify.org; echo; done", "summary": "Test Proxidize sticky session", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 200}
